practice.title: Practice
practice.description: Choose a level and strengthen your Regex skills with practical challenges.
practice.invalidRegex: This regular expression is not valid.
practice.keepTrying: The visible matches or additional test cases are not correct yet.
practice.resetConfirm: Reset all completed challenges in this level?
practice.level.beginner.title: Beginner
practice.level.beginner.description: Build confidence with matching, character sets, shorthand classes, quantifiers, and anchors.
practice.level.intermediate.title: Intermediate
practice.level.intermediate.description: Combine groups, boundaries, flags, escaping, and greedy or lazy matching in useful patterns.
practice.level.advanced.title: Advanced
practice.level.advanced.description: Solve realistic validation and extraction problems with lookarounds and structured patterns.
practice.challenge.beginner.literal.hint: Literal text can be written directly.
Use the global flag to collect every occurrence.
practice.challenge.beginner.dot.title: Match any middle character
practice.challenge.beginner.dot.descript: Match the three-letter words beginning with `c` and ending with `t`.
practice.challenge.beginner.dot.hint1: The dot represents any single character.
practice.challenge.beginner.character-se: Match both spellings `gray` and `grey`, but not `groy`.
practice.challenge.beginner.range.title: Use a letter range
practice.challenge.beginner.range.descri: Match codes containing an uppercase letter from A through C followed by one digit.
practice.challenge.beginner.range.hint1: A dash expresses an inclusive range.
Match the three-letter `b_t` words whose middle character is neither `a` nor `e`.
A caret at the beginning of a set negates it.
practice.challenge.beginner.digits.title: Extract numbers
practice.challenge.beginner.digits.descr: Match each complete sequence of one or more digits.
practice.challenge.beginner.digits.hint1: Use the digit shorthand character class.
practice.challenge.beginner.digits.hint2: Add a quantifier that means one or more.
practice.challenge.beginner.whitespace.d: Match each complete run of spaces or tabs.
practice.challenge.beginner.whitespace.h: The whitespace shorthand matches spaces and tabs.
Use `+` to keep adjacent whitespace together.
practice.challenge.beginner.optional.hin: The letter `u` may occur zero or one time.
practice.challenge.beginner.star.title: Allow zero or more
practice.challenge.beginner.star.hint1: The letter `o` can occur zero or more times.
practice.challenge.beginner.plus.title: Require one or more
practice.challenge.beginner.plus.hint1: The letter `o` must occur at least once.
practice.challenge.beginner.quantifier.d: Match sequences consisting of four consecutive digits.
practice.challenge.beginner.quantifier.h: Curly braces specify an exact repetition count.
Repeat the digit shorthand exactly four times.
practice.challenge.beginner.anchors.desc: Match `ERROR` only when it appears at the beginning of a line.
practice.challenge.beginner.anchors.hint: The caret anchors a pattern to the beginning.
Enable both global and multiline flags.
practice.challenge.intermediate.alternat: Match every occurrence of either `cat` or `dog`.
practice.challenge.intermediate.grouping: Match `red car` and `blue car`, but not other colors or vehicles.
Group the changing color before the shared word.
Use `(red|blue)` followed by a space and `car`.
practice.challenge.intermediate.backrefe: Match adjacent duplicate words, ignoring letter case.
Capture the first word and refer to that capture.
Use `\1` after whitespace and enable case-insensitive matching.
practice.challenge.intermediate.non-capt: Match the protocol portion of HTTP, HTTPS, and FTP URLs.
Group the protocol alternatives without capturing them.
practice.challenge.intermediate.boundari: Match `cat` as a complete word, not as part of a larger word.
practice.challenge.intermediate.escaping: Match dollar prices containing exactly two decimal digits.
Dollar signs and dots have special Regex meanings.
Escape both punctuation characters with backslashes.
practice.challenge.intermediate.greedy.d: Match from the first `<` through the final `>` as one result.
practice.challenge.intermediate.greedy.h: A dot and asterisk are greedy by default.
practice.challenge.intermediate.lazy.hin: Make the wildcard repetition stop as early as possible.
practice.challenge.intermediate.case-ins: Match every spelling of `error` regardless of capitalization.
The pattern itself can remain lowercase.
Enable the global and case-insensitive flags.
practice.challenge.intermediate.multilin: Match complete `NAME=value` lines and ignore malformed lines.
Anchor both ends of each valid line.
Use multiline mode with a word name, equals sign, and one or more values.
practice.challenge.intermediate.filename: Match complete PDF filenames made from word characters or dashes, without spaces.
Escape the dot before the extension.
Anchor each line and use `[\w-]+` for the filename.
practice.challenge.intermediate.urls.des: Match HTTP or HTTPS URLs with an optional single path segment.
practice.challenge.intermediate.urls.hin: Match the host, then use an optional grouped path.
practice.challenge.advanced.positive-loo: Match only the number immediately followed by ` USD`, without including the currency.
A positive lookahead checks following text without consuming it.
practice.challenge.advanced.negative-loo: Match complete username lines except the exact username `admin`.
Use a negative lookahead immediately after the line-start anchor.
Reject `admin` followed by the end of its line.
practice.challenge.advanced.positive-loo: Match numeric amounts preceded by `$` without including the dollar sign.
A positive lookbehind checks preceding text.
Start with `(?<=\$)` and allow an optional decimal portion.
practice.challenge.advanced.negative-loo: Match whole numbers that are not immediately preceded by `$`.
Use a negative lookbehind before the number.
practice.challenge.advanced.dates.title: Extract ISO-style dates
practice.challenge.advanced.dates.descri: Match zero-padded `YYYY-MM-DD` dates with month and day ranges.
practice.challenge.advanced.dates.hint1: Use alternatives for valid two-digit month and day ranges.
practice.challenge.advanced.emails.title: Extract email-like addresses
practice.challenge.advanced.emails.descr: Match conventional email addresses with a dotted domain and two-or-more-letter suffix.
practice.challenge.advanced.emails.hint1: Build separate local-name, domain, and suffix sections.
practice.challenge.advanced.emails.hint2: Allow word characters plus `.`, `+`, and `-` before `@`.
practice.challenge.advanced.ipv4.title: Validate IPv4 addresses
practice.challenge.advanced.ipv4.descrip: Match dotted IPv4 addresses only when every octet is between 0 and 255.
practice.challenge.advanced.ipv4.hint2: Repeat the octet-and-dot group three times, then match a final octet.
practice.challenge.advanced.semver.title: Extract semantic versions
practice.challenge.advanced.semver.descr: Match three-part numeric versions with an optional lowercase prerelease suffix.
practice.challenge.advanced.semver.hint1: Escape the dots between the three numeric parts.
practice.challenge.advanced.markdown-lin: Match complete Markdown links whose destination is an HTTP or HTTPS URL.
Escape the literal brackets and parentheses.
Use negated sets to stop the label at `]` and the URL at whitespace or `)`.
practice.challenge.advanced.csv-quotes.d: Match each double-quoted field, including commas and spaces inside it.
practice.challenge.advanced.csv-quotes.h: Between the quotes, allow anything except another quote.
Use a negated quote set repeated zero or more times.
practice.challenge.advanced.server-error: Match complete log lines whose HTTP status code is in the 500 range.
A server-error status begins with `5` and has two more digits.
Anchor the expression to complete lines in multiline mode.
practice.challenge.advanced.uuid.title: Extract UUID values
practice.challenge.advanced.uuid.descrip: Match canonical hexadecimal UUID values regardless of letter case.
practice.challenge.advanced.uuid.hint2: Use `[0-9a-f]` with exact quantifiers and enable case-insensitive matching.
page.practice.title: Regex Learn - Practice Regex
page.practice.description: Practice Regex with beginner, intermediate, and advanced interactive challenges.
